CREATE PROCEDURE DW.HIST_SP_DW_DIMCUSTOMER_CORP
AS
BEGIN

WITH TMP_CRMCCDSEC
AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT 
		BC.CUSTOMERID 
		,BCTN.TelephoneNumber               AS MobileNumber
		,BCE.EmailAddress                   AS Email
		,BLOC.LocationAddressLine1          AS AddressLine1
		,BLOC.LocationAddressLine2          AS AddressLine2
		,BCTY.CityName                      AS City
		,BSTT.StateName                     AS Province
		,BLOC.LocationZipCode               AS ZipCode
		,BLOC.CountryId                     AS Country
		,BCST.ConsentName                   AS DataPrivacyConsent
		,BACT.CustomerActionTimestamp       AS LastKYCDate
		,BC.SuspendedIndicator              AS SuspendedIndicator
		,BEMP.EmployerName                  AS EmployerName
		,BEMP.EmployerAddressLine1          AS OfficeAddressLine1
		,BEMP.EmployerAddressLine2          AS OfficeAddressLine2
		,BCTY2.CityName                     AS OfficeCity
		,BSTT2.StateName                    AS OfficeProvince
		,BEMP.ZipCode                       AS OfficeZipCode
		,BCTRY.IsoCountryName               AS OfficeCountry
		,BAZC.AnzsicClassName               AS Industry
		,BJT.JobTitleName                   AS Occupation
		,BC.SourceSystemCode                AS SourceSystemCode
		,BC.FinancialInstitutionId          AS FinancialInstitutionId
    FROM (SELECT CUSTOMERID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId,SuspendedIndicator FROM BNKM.Customer WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM') BC
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY PeriodStartTimestamp desc  ) rn, CustomerId,TelephoneNumber,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber WHERE PreferenceId = 'Y' AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000') BCTN ON BC.CustomerId = BCTN.CustomerId  AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCTN.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCTN.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY ConsentId  ) rn, CustomerId,ConsentId,FinancialInstitutionId FROM  BNKM.CustomerConsent where PeriodEndDate is NULL) BCC ON BC.CustomerId = BCC.CustomerId  AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCC.RN = 1  --CRM
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ConsentId,ConsentName FROM BNKM.Consent) BCST ON BCC.ConsentId = BCST.ConsentId --CRM
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerId,CustomerActionTimestamp,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerAction) BACT ON BC.CustomerId = BACT.CustomerId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BACT.FinancialInstitutionId  --CRM
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY PeriodStartTimestamp desc ) rn, CustomerId,LocationId,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation WHERE PreferenceId = 'Y' AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '2099-12-31T00:00:00.0000000' ) BCL ON BC.CustomerId = BCL.CustomerId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCL.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCL.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT LocationId,LocationAddressLine1,LocationAddressLine2,LocationZipCode,CountryId ,LocationCity,LocationStateId,FinancialInstitutionId  FROM BNKM.Location) BLOC ON BCL.LocationId = BLOC.LocationId AND BCL.FinancialInstitutionId = BLOC.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,EmailTypeId,EmailAddress,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail WHERE PreferenceId = 'Y' AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01') BCE ON BC.CustomerId = BCE.CustomerId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCE.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CityId,CityName,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.City) BCTY ON BLOC.LocationCity = BCTY.CityId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCTY.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT StateId,StateName,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.[STATE]) BSTT   ON BLOC.LocationStateId = BSTT.StateId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BSTT.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT row_number() over(partition by customerid,FinancialInstitutionId order by customerid,JobTitleId) rn, CustomerId,CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),EmployerId,1) EmployerId,JobTitleId,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL) BCEMP ON BC.CustomerId = BCEMP.CustomerId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCEMP.FinancialInstitutionId  AND BCEMP.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT row_number() over(partition by EmployerId,FinancialInstitutionId order by EmployerId,EmployerName) rn, EmployerId,EmployerName,EmployerAddressLine1,EmployerAddressLine2,CityId,StateId,ZipCode,Country,AnzsicClassCode,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.Employer) BEMP ON BCEMP.EmployerId = BEMP.EmployerId AND BCEMP.FinancialInstitutionId = BEMP.FinancialInstitutionId AND BEMP.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CityId,CityName,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.City) BCTY2 ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BEMP.CityId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCTY2.CityId) AND BCTY.FinancialInstitutionId = BEMP.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT StateId,StateName,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.[STATE]) BSTT2   ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BEMP.StateId) = convert(varchar,BSTT2.StateId) AND BEMP.FinancialInstitutionId = BSTT2.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CountryId,IsoCountryName FROM BNKM.Country) BCTRY ON  BEMP.Country = convert(varchar,BCTRY.CountryId)
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT AnzsicClassCode,AnzsicClassName FROM BNKM.AnzsicClass) BAZC ON BEMP.AnzsicClassCode = BAZC.AnzsicClassCode
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT JobTitleId,JobTitleName,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.JobTitle)  BJT ON BCEMP.JobTitleId = BJT.JobTitleId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BJT.FinancialInstitutionId

   UNION ALL

   SELECT DISTINCT 
		BC.CUSTOMERID 
	   ,BCTN.TelephoneNumber               AS MobileNumber
	   ,BCE.EmailAddress                   AS Email
	   ,BLOC.LocationAddressLine1          AS AddressLine1
	   ,BLOC.LocationAddressLine2          AS AddressLine2   
	   ,BLOC.LocationCity                  AS City
	   ,BLOC.LocationStateId               AS Province
	   ,BLOC.LocationZipCode               AS ZipCode 
	   ,BLOC.CountryId                     AS Country
	   ,NULL                               AS DataPrivacyConsent
	   ,NULL                               AS LastKYCDate  
	   ,'CCD'                              AS SuspendedIndicator
	   ,BEMP.EmployerName                  AS EmployerName
	   ,BEMP.EmployerAddressLine1          AS OfficeAddressLine1
	   ,BEMP.EmployerAddressLine2          AS OfficeAddressLine2 
	   ,BEMP.CityId                        AS OfficeCity
	   ,BEMP.StateId                       AS OfficeProvince
	   ,BEMP.ZipCode                       AS OfficeZipCode
	   ,BEMP.Country                       AS OfficeCountry
	   ,BEMP.AnzsicClassCode               AS Industry
	   ,BCEMP.JobTitleId                   AS Occupation
	   ,BC.SourceSystemCode                AS SourceSystemCode
	   ,BC.FinancialInstitutionId          AS FinancialInstitutionId
   FROM (SELECT CUSTOMERID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.Customer WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD') BC
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,TelephoneNumber FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber BCTN where SourceCode = 'CCD' AND TelephoneNumberTypeId = 'Mobile Number' AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL) BCTN ON BC.CustomerId = BCTN.CustomerId  
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,LocationId FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation WHERE LocationTypeId = '1'  AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL) BCL ON BC.CustomerId = BCL.CustomerId 
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT LocationId,LocationAddressLine1,LocationAddressLine2,LocationCity,LocationStateId,LocationZipCode,CountryId FROM BNKM.Location) BLOC ON BCL.LocationId = BLOC.LocationId
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,EmailAddress FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail BCE WHERE EmailTypeId = 'Primary' AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL) BCE ON BC.CustomerId = BCE.CustomerId
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,EmployerId,JobTitleId FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL) BCEMP ON BC.CustomerId = BCEMP.CustomerId
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT EmployerId,EmployerName,EmployerAddressLine1,EmployerAddressLine2,CityId,StateId,ZipCode,Country,AnzsicClassCode FROM BNKM.Employer) BEMP ON BCEMP.EmployerId = BEMP.EmployerId

   UNION ALL

   SELECT DISTINCT BC.CUSTOMERID 
   ,BCTN.TelephoneNumber               AS MobileNumber
   ,BCE.EmailAddress                   AS Email
   ,BLOC.LocationAddressLine1          AS AddressLine1
   ,BLOC.LocationAddressLine2          AS AddressLine2
   ,BLOC.LocationCity                  AS City   
   ,BLOC.LocationStateId               AS Province 
   ,BLOC.LocationZipCode               AS ZipCode
   ,BLOC.CountryId                     AS Country
   ,CASE WHEN BCAP.CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL THEN 'OPTED IN FOR ALL'
    ELSE NULL END                      AS DataPrivacyConsent
   ,convert(date,convert(varchar,BCAP.CustomerAccountOpenedDate)) AS LastKYCDate
   ,'SEC'                              AS SuspendedIndicator
   ,BEMP.EmployerName                  AS EmployerName
   ,BEMP.EmployerAddressLine1          AS OfficeAddressLine1
   ,BEMP.EmployerAddressLine2          AS OfficeAddressLine2
   ,BEMP.CityId                        AS OfficeCity
   ,BEMP.StateId                       AS OfficeProvince
   ,BEMP.ZipCode                       AS OfficeZipCode
   ,BEMP.Country                       AS OfficeCountry
   ,BEMP.BusinessNature                AS Industry
   ,BCEMP.JobTitleId                   AS Occupation
   ,BC.SourceSystemCode                AS SourceSystemCode
   ,BC.FinancialInstitutionId          AS FinancialInstitutionId
   FROM (SELECT CUSTOMERID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.Customer WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'SEC' ) BC
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY TelephoneNumber DESC) rn, CustomerId,TelephoneNumber FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber BCTN WHERE TelephoneNumberTypeId = 'Cellphone Number' AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL AND TelephoneNumber not in ('O','0')) BCTN ON BC.CustomerId = BCTN.CustomerId AND BCTN.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CUSTOMERID ORDER BY CustomerAccountOpenedDate DESC) RN, * FROM (
                SELECT BCAP.CustomerId,BCARD.CustomerAccountId,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation BCAP
                LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId  FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountRelatedDigitalAccount) BCARD ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCARD.CustomerAccountId 
                LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountOpenedDate FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
                WHERE BCAP.SourceSystemCode  ='SEC' ) BCAP
                ) BCAP ON BC.CustomerId = BCAP.CustomerId AND BCAP.RN = 1
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,LocationId FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation WHERE LocationTypeId = 'Home'  AND SourceCode = 'SEC' AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL) BCL ON BC.CustomerId = BCL.CustomerId 
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROW_NUMBER()  OVER(PARTITION BY LocationId ORDER BY LocationId DESC) rn, LocationId,LocationAddressLine1,LocationAddressLine2,LocationCity,LocationStateId,LocationZipCode,CountryId FROM BNKM.Location) BLOC ON BCL.LocationId = BLOC.LocationId AND BLOC.RN = 1
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,EmailAddress FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail BCE WHERE SourceCode = 'SEC' AND EmailTypeId = 'Primary' ) BCE ON BC.CustomerId = BCE.CustomerId
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId,EmployerId,JobTitleId FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL) BCEMP ON BC.CustomerId = BCEMP.CustomerId
   LEFT JOIN (SELECT EmployerId,EmployerName,EmployerAddressLine1,EmployerAddressLine2,CityId,StateId,ZipCode,Country,BusinessNature FROM BNKM.Employer) BEMP ON CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),BCEMP.EmployerId,1) = CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),BEMP.EmployerId,1))

SELECT * INTO #TMP_CRMCCDSEC FROM TMP_CRMCCDSEC;


WITH CustomerSK as (SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerSK),0) RN FROM dw.DimCustomer),

TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMER
AS (
SELECT 
	ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM CustomerSK)  AS CustomerSK, * FROM (
		SELECT DISTINCT
	 BC.CustomerId AS CustomerID
	,BLEC.LegalEntityName AS CustomerName
	,BCT.CustomerTypeName AS CustomerType
	,NULL AS DateOfBirth
	,BMS.MaritalStatusName AS MaritalStatus
	,NULL AS Gender
	,TMPCCS.MobileNumber AS MobileNumber
	,TMPCCS.Email AS Email
	,TMPCCS.AddressLine1 AS AddressLine1
	,TMPCCS.AddressLine2 AS AddressLine2
	,TMPCCS.City AS City
	,TMPCCS.Province AS Province
	,TMPCCS.ZipCode AS ZipCode
	,TMPCCS.Country AS Country
	,TMPCCS.DataPrivacyConsent AS DataPrivacyConsent
	,TMPCCS.LastKYCDate AS LastKYCDate
	,TMPCCS.SuspendedIndicator AS SuspendedIndicator
	,BC.CustomerEstablishedDate AS RelationshipStartDate
	,BCRP.PartyId AS GlobalCIF
	,CASE WHEN BCRC.RelatedCustomerId IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ATMEnrollmentIndicator
	,CASE WHEN BCA.CustomerId IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator --MBK
	,CASE WHEN BCA2.CustomerId IS NOT NULL OR BCAP.CoreCustomerId IS NOT NULL 
	THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator --RIB/BOB
	,NULL AS GenerationalCohortSK
	,TMPCCS.EmployerName
	,TMPCCS.OfficeAddressLine1
	,TMPCCS.OfficeAddressLine2
	,TMPCCS.OfficeCity
	,TMPCCS.OfficeProvince
	,TMPCCS.OfficeZipCode
	,TMPCCS.OfficeCountry
	,TMPCCS.Industry
	,TMPCCS.Occupation
	,BLEC.LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment AS DateOfIncorporation
	,BLEC.SMEClassification AS SMEClassification
	,BLEC.AnzsicClassCode AS LineOfActivity
	,AnzsicClassName AS IndustryDescription
	,BLEC.SectorCode AS Subsector
	,BSTOR.SectorName AS SubsectorDescription
	,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
	,BC.BranchId AS BranchSK
	,1 AS CurrentIndicator
	,ISNULL(CustomerEstablishedDate,BC.InsertDttm) AS ValidStartDate
    ,LEAD(ISNULL(CustomerEstablishedDate,BC.InsertDttm), 1 ,'9999-12-31') OVER 
            (PARTITION BY CustomerID ,InsertDttm ,SourceSystemCode 
            ORDER BY CustomerID ,InsertDttm ,SourceSystemCode) 
    AS ValidEndDate
	,BC.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.Customer BC
JOIN #TMP_CRMCCDSEC TMPCCS ON BC.CustomerId = TMPCCS.CUSTOMERID AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = TMPCCS.FinancialInstitutionId
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT LegalEntityName,SMEClassification,AnzsicClassCode,SectorCode,CustomerId,LegalEntityDateOfEstablishment FROM BNKM.LegalEntityCustomer) BLEC ON BC.CustomerId  = BLEC.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT * FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedParty where PeriodEndTimestamp is null )  BCRP ON BC.CustomerId = BCRP.CustomerId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCRP.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerType BCT ON BC.CustomerTypeId= CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCT.CustomerTypeId) AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCT.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * from BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL) BCMS ON BC.CustomerId = BCMS.CustomerId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.MaritalStatus BMS ON BCMS.MaritalStatusId  = convert(varchar,BMS.MaritalStatusId)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer where PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL) BCRC ON BC.CustomerId = BCRC.RelatedCustomerId 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BC.CustomerId = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA.CustomerId) and BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'MBK' --MBK
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA2 ON BC.CustomerId = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCA2.CustomerId) and BCA2.SourceSystemCode = 'RIB' --RIB
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CoreCustomerId FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation BCAP
            JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId FROM BNKM.BusinessOnlineBankingAccount) BOBA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BOBA.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode IN ('DEP','LNS')
            ) BCAP ON BCAP.CoreCustomerId = BC.CoreCustomerId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BC.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN BNKM.AnzsicClass BAZC ON  BLEC.AnzsicClassCode = BAZC.AnzsicClassCode AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BAZC.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.Sector BSTOR ON BLEC.SectorCode = BSTOR.SectorCode
)A)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMER FROM TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMER;

INSERT INTO DW.DimCustomer 
	([CustomerSK]
	,[CustomerID]
	,[CustomerName]
	,[CustomerType]
	,[DateOfBirth]
	,[MaritalStatus]
	,[Gender]
	,[MobileNumber]
	,[Email]
	,[AddressLine1]
	,[AddressLine2]
	,[City]
	,[Province]
	,[ZipCode]
	,[Country]
	,[DataPrivacyConsent]
	,[LastKYCDate]
	,[SuspendedIndicator]
	,[RelationshipStartDate]
	,[GlobalCIF]
	,[ATMEnrollmentIndicator]
	,[MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator]
	,[OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator]
	,[GenerationalCohortSK]
	,[EmployerName]
	,[OfficeAddressLine1]
	,[OfficeAddressLine2]
	,[OfficeCity]
	,[OfficeProvince]
	,[OfficeZipCode]
	,[OfficeCountry]
	,[Industry]
	,[Occupation]
	,[DateOfIncorporation]
	,[SMEClassification]
	,[LineOfActivity]
	,[IndustryDescription]
	,[Subsector]
	,[SubsectorDescription]
	,[BankSK]
	,[BranchSK]
	,[CurrentIndicator]
	,[ValidStartDate]
	,[ValidEndDate]
	,[SourceSystemCode]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])
SELECT
	 CustomerSK
	,SRC.CustomerID
	,CustomerName
	,CustomerType
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,DateOfBirth))
	,MaritalStatus
	,Gender
	,MobileNumber
	,Email
	,AddressLine1
	,AddressLine2
	,City
	,Province
	,ZipCode
	,Country
	,DataPrivacyConsent
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,LastKYCDate))
	,SuspendedIndicator
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,RelationshipStartDate))
	,GlobalCIF
	,ATMEnrollmentIndicator
	,MobileBankingEnrollmentIndicator
	,OnlineBankingEnrollmentIndicator
	,GenerationalCohortSK
	,EmployerName
	,OfficeAddressLine1
	,OfficeAddressLine2
	,OfficeCity
	,OfficeProvince
	,OfficeZipCode
	,OfficeCountry
	,Industry
	,Occupation
	,DateOfIncorporation
	,SMEClassification
	,LineOfActivity
	,IndustryDescription
	,Subsector
	,SubsectorDescription
	,SRC.BankSK
	,BranchSK
	,CurrentIndicator
	,ValidStartDate
	,ValidEndDate
	,SourceSystemCode
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_DW_DIMCUSTOMER SRC

END
